description: 东西不合适或坏了，怎么问清退货政策、选择换货或退款，并把钱退到正确的地方。

targetChunks.note: return 是最通用的退货说法；比 give it back 正式。
店员最常问的第一句；电子收据也可以。

targetChunks.en: I bought it last week, but it doesn't fit.
targetChunks.note: 说清时间和原因；退货理由要具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I bought it last week, but it doesn't fit.

targetChunks.note: under warranty = 在保修期内；电子产品必问。

targetChunks.en: I'd prefer an exchange, not a refund.
targetChunks.note: exchange / refund 的选择要明确；prefer 比 want 委婉。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'd prefer an exchange, not a refund.

targetChunks.zh: 你们的退货政策是什么？
targetChunks.note: 问政策，避免白跑；常见 30-day return policy。
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你们的退货政策是什么？

targetChunks.en: Can I get store credit instead?
targetChunks.note: store credit = 店内余额/积分，不能退现金时的替代。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can I get store credit instead?

targetChunks.en: It stopped working after two days.
targetChunks.note: stopped working = 坏了；比 it's broken 更有时间线。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It stopped working after two days.

targetChunks.en: Could you check the serial number?
targetChunks.note: serial number 用于验证保修和真伪。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Could you check the serial number?

targetChunks.en: I paid by card — will it go back to the same card?
targetChunks.zh: 我刷卡付的，会退到原卡吗？
targetChunks.note: 退款路径要确认；有时只能退 store credit。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I paid by card — will it go back to the same card?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我刷卡付的，会退到原卡吗？

targetChunks.note: sort out = 解决；收尾给对方面子。

roleplay.promptZh: 你买了两天的耳机坏了，带着收据去退货。你要问清政策、选择换货或退款、确认退款路径。
roleplay.promptEn: Your headphones broke after two days. Return them with the receipt, ask about the policy, choose exchange or refund, and confirm how the money comes back.
goals: 明确选择换货还是退款
确认退款到原卡的时间

script.speaker: you
script.en: Hi, I'd like to return these headphones.

script.speaker: you
script.en: Yes. I bought them last week, but they stopped working after two days.
script.zh: 有。我上周买的，但用了两天就坏了。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Yes. Could you check the serial number? What's your return policy?
script.zh: 在。能查一下序列号吗？你们的退货政策是什么？

script.speaker: other
script.en: You can exchange them or get a refund within thirty days.
script.zh: 三十天内可以换货或退款。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I'd prefer an exchange, not a refund.

script.speaker: other
script.en: No problem. Do you have the card you paid with?
script.zh: 没问题。你带了付款的卡吗？

script.speaker: you
script.en: I paid by card — will it go back to the same card? Let me make sure I've got this right.
script.zh: 我刷卡付的，会退到原卡吗？我确认一下。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Great. Thanks for sorting this out.
